The most transferable context (C17) has no reported external condition, so the fed-state effect on the query is not directly matched.
First-pass metabolism and efflux for the query are inferred from physicochemical similarity to saquinavir, not directly measured.
Predicted low solubility is not experimentally confirmed; formulation and food effects could alter exposure.
